# 49. Group Anagrams

[LeetCode](https://leetcode.com/problems/group-anagrams/) · **Medium** · Pattern: [Arrays & Hashing](README.md) · [All patterns](../README.md) · [Home](../../README.md)

> **Key insight:** Anagrams share a letter-count signature; use the 26-count tuple as a dict key.

## Approach

1. Anagrams share a letter-count signature; use the 26-count tuple as a dict key.
2. Complexity: time `O(n * k)`, space `O(n * k)`.

| | Complexity |
|---|---|
| Time | `O(n * k)` |
| Space | `O(n * k)` |

## Solution

<!-- prep:solutions:start -->
<details>
<summary><b>Python</b> (spoiler) · <code>0049-group-anagrams.py</code></summary>

```python
from collections import defaultdict
from typing import List


class Solution:
    def groupAnagrams(self, strs: List[str]) -> List[List[str]]:
        groups = defaultdict(list)
        for s in strs:
            count = [0] * 26
            for c in s:
                count[ord(c) - ord("a")] += 1
            groups[tuple(count)].append(s)
        return list(groups.values())
```

</details>
<!-- prep:solutions:end -->
